PreToolUse.message: Before creating: check if a similar file already exists via file_search. Never duplicate files.
Before editing: include 3+ lines of context. Use multi_replace for 2+ independent edits. Never use oldString from summarized docs.
Prefer run_task for workspace tasks (Vitest, Playwright, lint, build). Prefer get_errors for single-file diagnostics. PowerShell only — never bash.

PostToolUse.message: Post-edit: verify RTL · CSS vars · cGet→null · textContent · dialog+showModal · layer order · card-id=registry-id. Run get_errors on changed files.
